results.title: Why HubSpot Chose Amplitude for Product Analytics Over a Homegrown Solution
results.content:
Managing system outages and reliability issues was what Dan described as the “monster” of all issues. “This was like a death spiral,” he explained. “It got to the point where people were increasingly skeptical of the data that came out of the system and not using it very much.”

Ultimately, frustration and doubt in the data’s integrity started to bubble up and spread through the organization. It was becoming a major drain on time and resources. “Talk to anybody on the product team at HubSpot and they will tell you that they were a bit frustrated with the system because of the slow load times, changing data and unreliable reports,” Dan said. “And it was built by some very smart and talented people.” [...] Using behavioral cohorts, the teams are making big discoveries about which types of accounts are performing better than others. From there, they can understand how to improve the experience for those underperforming cohorts. “That’s a really, really exciting thing for a team to discover,” Dan added.

At the end of the day, product analytics that reveals user behavior is essential in building and growing products. For HubSpot, Amplitude provided the most cost effective, reliable, customizable solution to fill their needs.

#### Bring clarity and speed to your company like HubSpot.

Book your personalized demo below and get started today!

## Recommended [...] HubSpot decided to host a cost/benefit “bake off” where they presented options for investing more resources into their internal tool versus buying a vendor solution. A “Perfect” vendor is a Myth, But Beats Building It Yourself Amplitude won the bake off, with an honest caveat: there’s no such thing as the perfect tool.

“Ultimately,” Dan said, “I think there’s no solution that will give you everything you need for every single analysis you have to do.” While you think a perfect tool exists you will drive yourself crazy looking for it. As Dan put it, “we thought we were a special snowflake and things we had to have were mission critical.”

# AI Feedback

AI Feedback automatically groups customer feedback from support tickets, app reviews, call recordings, and social channels into categories such as feature requests, complaints, and bugs, then connects those insights to Amplitude cohorts, session replays, and experiments so you can investigate and act on them. You can also create guides and surveys directly from insights.
